purpose: Pre-specification of a confirmatory test of replay recall on an arm that has not been opened for audit or replay analysis. Written after the hypothesis was formed on Terra and Qwen3 and BEFORE any replay quantity is computed on Kimi.

hypothesis_origin.observed: Qwen3 invariant-replay recall B1 minus B0 = +29.82 pp, 95% CI [+17.14, +42.23], paired permutation p = 0.0002, 32 memory clusters.

confirmatory_sample.verified_inputs: 1,440 records; 1,382 COMPLETED_VALID (B0 462 / M0 456 / B1 464); 58 truncated; rule_correct present on all valid
confirmatory_sample.input_parser: qa1c (frozen), re-parsed from responses_raw.jsonl by scripts/rescore_kimi_qa1c.py
confirmatory_sample.why_not_the_qa1b_scoring_records: The run directory scoring_records.jsonl predates the qa1c parser fix and marks 93 responses truncated instead of 58. The frozen Kimi decision result (+9.79 pp, 16 August 2026) was computed on the qa1c parse. A confirmatory test must use the same valid set as the frozen decision result, and that choice is fixed here, before signature, so it cannot be made after seeing anything.

primary_endpoint.name: invariant-replay recall difference, B1 minus B0
primary_endpoint.unit: canonical context with all three renderings valid
primary_endpoint.detector: the three renderings return different rule_id values (oracle-free)
primary_endpoint.recall: among contexts containing at least one rule error (oracle), the fraction flagged by the detector
primary_endpoint.aggregation: per memory: (flagged erroneous contexts, erroneous contexts); pooled ratio within each bootstrap resample
primary_endpoint.contrast: B1_VERIFIED_MEMORY minus B0_LLM_ALONE, paired on memory
primary_endpoint.inference: paired memory-clustered bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 13082652, two-sided 95% percentile interval; paired permutation test as robustness
primary_endpoint.success_criterion: 95% interval excludes zero with a positive point estimate

secondary_endpoints.name: oracle-free rule-consistency difference, B1 minus B0
secondary_endpoints.role: descriptive; shows the aggregate falls while recall rises

secondary_endpoints.name: citation stability among all-correct minus among with-error contexts, B1 vs B0

exclusions: contexts with fewer than three valid renderings are dropped and their count reported by condition; no other exclusion
multiplicity: one primary endpoint; secondaries descriptive; no adjustment required
what_would_disconfirm: an interval including zero, or a negative point estimate
limits: no identical-replay axis for Kimi (no repeat run); single arm; 32 memory clusters, coverage near 92.5% against nominal 95%

amendments.change: input pinned to the qa1c re-parse by sha256; qa1b scoring_records.jsonl replaced
amendments.reason: consistency with the frozen decision result; pre-signature, pre-inspection

refuses_to_run_unless: no prior confirmatory result file exists
runner.dry_run: --dry-run-on reserved_qwen3 reproduces the exploratory +29.82 without touching Kimi
